tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search BotShelf Vampire items by words. Every word must match the title, description, where-it-runs, topic or keywords. Returns short cards; call get_item for the full text.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get one item by id (the site path from a search or list result, for example /library/claude-code/code-review/). Returns its card and, when the item has a plain file that is open without sign-up, the full text. Long text comes in parts: pass next_offset as offset to read on.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List items in shelf order, with optional filters, a page at a time. Also returns how many items each kind holds.
